purpose: Find and verify a bounded static clearance repair, preserving source assets and exposing a reusable parameterized procedure to professional crews.

properties.path: new output directory; contains source/repaired libraries, actual before/after GLBs and repair report
properties.database: existing local sticker registry, never changed by repair
properties.moving: one direct child permitted to translate
properties.fixed: 1..8 other direct children to check; other pairs remain untested
properties.search_steps: optional 1..16 cold search samples; defaults to 8
properties.procedure: optional supported axm.clearance-procedure/v1; crews retrieve it only within the same evidence binding

relationships: uses actual UC triangle clearance and immutable sticker assembly exports
crew observations reconstruct artifacts and recheck the procedure before learning
limitations: Static rigid rest pose only; no steering/suspension sweep, physics, assembly-strength or visual-quality acceptance.
A bounded discrete search is not a global or minimum-displacement optimizer.
The retained rule recalculates from new bounds and still requires fresh triangle verification.
Only caller-selected pairs are checked. Unsupported geometry, motion and exceeded bounds do not grant a learned procedure.
